sections.title: Interrogative Sentences (Yes/No Type)
sections.content:
Yes/No questions को indirect में assertive sentence बनाया जाता है।

Rule:
1. Reporting verb (asked, inquired) पहचानें।
2. If या whether लगाएं।
3. Question form को statement form में बदलें।
4. Tense और pronoun नियम लागू करें।

Example:
Direct: He said to me, "Are you ready?"
Step 1: said to → asked
Step 2: if जोड़ें
Step 3: are you → I was (statement order)
Indirect: He asked me if I was ready.

sections.title: Interrogative Sentences (Wh- Type)
sections.content:
Wh- word (what, why, where, when, how) बना रहता है, but sentence assertive बनता है।

Rule:
1. said to → asked
2. Wh-word को रखें (no if/whether)
3. Helping verb हटाकर subject पहले रखें
4. Tense change लागू करें

Example:
Direct: She said, "Where do you live?"
Step 1: said → asked
Step 2: where रहेगा
Step 3: do you live → I lived
Indirect: She asked where I lived.

sections.title: Imperative Sentences (Order, Request, Advice)
sections.content:
Imperative sentences में आदेश, निवेदन या सलाह होती है। Indirect में to + V1 प्रयोग होता है।

Rule:
1. Reporting verb अर्थ अनुसार बदलें (ordered, requested, advised)
2. Comma हटाकर to + V1 लगाएं
3. Negative हो तो not to + V1

Example:
Direct: He said to me, "Open the door."
Step 1: said to → ordered
Step 2: open → to open
Indirect: He ordered me to open the door.

Negative Example:
Direct: She said, "Do not run."
Step 1: said → advised
Step 2: do not run → not to run
Indirect: She advised not to run.

sections.title: Exclamatory Sentences
sections.content:
Exclamatory sentences में strong feeling होती है। Indirect में exclaimed + feeling word प्रयोग होता है।

Rule:
1. exclaimed प्रयोग करें
2. Feeling जोड़ें (with joy, sorrow, surprise)
3. What/How हटाकर that से जोड़ें

Example:
Direct: He said, "What a beautiful place!"
Step 1: said → exclaimed with joy
Step 2: what हटाएं
Step 3: that जोड़ें
Indirect: He exclaimed with joy that it was a very beautiful place.

sections.title: Time और Place Word Conversion
sections.content:
Indirect speech में समय और स्थान शब्द बदल जाते हैं (यदि reporting verb past हो)।

Common Changes:
today → that day
tomorrow → the next day
yesterday → the previous day
now → then
here → there
this → that

Example:
Direct: He said, "I will come tomorrow."
Step 1: will → would
Step 2: tomorrow → the next day
Indirect: He said that he would come the next day.

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. Question को statement में न बदलना।
2. If/whether का प्रयोग भूल जाना।
3. Imperative में to + V1 न लगाना।
4. Time words न बदलना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content:
1. Question → assertive form।
2. Yes/No → if/whether।
3. Wh-question → Wh-word रखें।
4. Order/Request → to + V1।
5. Exclamation → exclaimed with feeling।
6. Time/Place words बदलें।

tricks.title: Yes/No Shortcut
tricks.explanation: Question दिखे और answer Yes/No हो सकता है तो if/whether लगाओ।
tricks.example: He asked if I was coming.

tricks.title: Wh- Word Rule
tricks.explanation: Wh-word हटाना नहीं है, सिर्फ sentence order बदलना है।

tricks.title: Question से Statement ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: Helping verb हटाकर subject पहले रखो।
tricks.example: Are you ready? → I was ready.

tricks.title: Imperative पहचानो
tricks.explanation: Sentence verb से शुरू हो तो to + V1 लगाओ।
tricks.example: Close the door → to close the door.

tricks.title: Negative Command Trick
tricks.explanation: Do not दिखे तो not to + V1 बनाओ।
tricks.example: Do not smoke → not to smoke.

tricks.title: Exclamation पहचानो
tricks.explanation: What/How + ! दिखे तो exclaimed with लगाओ।
tricks.example: He exclaimed with surprise that it was amazing.

tricks.title: Time Change Quick List
tricks.example: She said she would go the next day.

tricks.title: 3-Step Question Formula
tricks.example: He asked me if I had finished.

tricks.title: Feeling Word जोड़ो
tricks.explanation: Joy, sorrow, surprise में से सही भावना चुनो।
tricks.example: She exclaimed with sorrow that she was tired.

tricks.title: Final Check Rule
tricks.explanation: Indirect speech में question mark नहीं रहेगा।
